method_fidelity_checklist.definition: Two-phase MAPF solver: (1) MARL-inspired decentralized cooperative policy generates initial collision-reducing paths, (2) LNS framework with Prioritized Planning repairs remaining collisions
assumptions: Agents have distinct start and goal positions on free cells
Vertex and swapping collisions must be avoided
invariants: All agents must reach their goals in a valid solution
No vertex or swapping collisions in final solution
LNS iterations must not increase colliding pairs
non_negotiable_steps: Phase 2: LNS iterative neighborhood selection and repair
Acceptance criterion: new plan has <= colliding pairs than current
deviations: MARL component uses heuristic cooperative policy instead of trained neural network (no deep learning framework available)
Single-agent pathfinding uses Space-Time A* instead of SIPPS (simpler but functional)
Limited time budgets for each phase (20s total per instance)
